discord.invalid_token: The bot token is invalid or was reset. Connect again in Settings.
discord.members_intent: Listing members needs the Server Members intent. Enter the user ID instead.
discord.no_access: The bot can't see this channel. Check the channel permissions for the bot.
discord.no_channels: The bot can't see any text channels on this server.
discord.no_permission: The bot lacks the Send Messages permission in this channel.
discord.no_servers: The bot is not on any server yet. Invite it first (see SETUP.md).
discord.no_token: Not connected — add a bot token in Settings
discord.rate_limited: Discord rate limit reached. Try again in {secs} s.
discord.unknown_channel: Channel not found. Check the channel ID.
discord.unknown_guild: Server not found, or the bot is not a member of it.
discord.unknown_user: User not found. Check the user ID.
editor.already_added: This shortcut is already in the list.
editor.conditions_hint: All conditions are optional. When set, the binding runs only if they are true at the moment you press the keys.
editor.cooldown_hint: Seconds between two runs of this binding. Minimum 0.01 s (10 ms). Discord's own rate limits still apply.
editor.hint_double_tap: Runs when the shortcut is pressed twice within {ms} ms (change in Settings).
editor.hint_long_press: Runs after the shortcut is held for {ms} ms (change in Settings).
editor.hint_press: Runs once when the shortcut is pressed.
editor.hint_release: Runs once when the shortcut is released.
editor.hint_repeat: Runs right away, then repeats while the keys are held, up to the limit.
editor.hint_toggle: First press starts repeating, the next press stops it. The limit always applies.
editor.name: Name
editor.no_shortcuts: No shortcut — run it with the button or from the tray.
editor.notify: Show a notification after it runs
editor.priority_hint: 0–9. When one key press matches several bindings, the higher priority wins.
editor.process: Only when this program is active
editor.process_hint: Program file name, for example chrome.exe. Leave empty for any program.
editor.prompt_combo: Hold all keys together, then release them.
editor.prompt_sequence: Press the keys one after another, then click Stop.
editor.prompt_standard: Press the shortcut, e.g. F8 or Ctrl + Q. Esc cancels.
editor.record_hint: Choose a type, click Record and press your keys. Up to 3 shortcuts.
editor.skip_fullscreen: Don't run while a fullscreen app (game, video) is active
editor.uses_hook: Detected by NoKey's keyboard hook. The keys still reach the active app.
editor.window_title: Only when the window title contains
editor.window_title_hint: Case does not matter. Leave empty for any window.
editor.works_everywhere: Works in every app, even when NoKey is in the tray.
err.app_blocked: Command shells and script hosts can't be started by NoKey.
err.app_type: Choose an .exe file or a shortcut (.lnk).
err.channel_id: The channel ID must be a 17–20 digit number.
err.file_blocked: Programs, scripts and shortcuts can't be opened as files. Use Open Application for programs.
err.guild_first: Enter or load the server ID first.
err.guild_id: The server ID must be a 17–20 digit number.
err.hotkey_in_use: is already used by Windows or another app
err.hotkey_taken: Saved, but the shortcut {details}. Choose another shortcut or close the app that uses it.
err.name: Enter a name.
err.path_chars: The path contains characters that aren't allowed.
err.profile_builtin: Default profiles can be renamed but not deleted.
err.repeat_discord: Discord pings can't repeat automatically. Use Press, Release, Double Tap or Long Press.
err.repo: Enter the GitHub repository with NoKey releases as owner/name.
err.shell_no_association: no app is set to open this type of file
err.token_empty: Paste the bot token first. SETUP.md shows where to find it.
err.token_spaces: The token must not contain spaces.
err.too_many_actions: A binding can have at most 10 actions.
err.too_many_shortcuts: A binding can have at most 3 shortcuts.
err.tray: The tray icon could not be added.
err.url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https:// (no spaces or quotes).
err.user_id: The user ID must be a 17–20 digit number.
hint.app: Programs and shortcuts. Command shells and script hosts are blocked.
hint.channel_cue: Load the list or paste an ID
hint.developer_mode: Discord: Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click → Copy User ID.
hint.server_cue: Load the list or paste an ID
hint.url: Opens in your default browser. http:// and https:// only.
main.empty:
No bindings in this profile yet.
Click “+ New binding” to create one.
main.status_disabled: All bindings are off. Ctrl + Alt + Pause turns them back on.
main.status_enabled: Bindings are active. Ctrl + Alt + Pause turns everything off.
notify.still_running: NoKey is still running. Your shortcuts keep working. Right-click the tray icon to exit.
settings.confirm_delete_profile: Delete this profile? Its bindings move to the Default profile.
settings.confirm_disconnect: Remove the saved bot token? Discord Ping stops working until you connect again.
settings.confirm_download:
NoKey {version} is available (installed: v{current}).

What's new:
{notes}

Download and verify it now? Nothing is installed until you confirm again.
settings.confirm_install:
The update was downloaded and its SHA-256 checksum matches.

Restart NoKey now to install it? Your settings and bindings are kept.
settings.discord_help: NoKey sends mentions through your own Discord bot. SETUP.md explains how to create it, get the token and invite it to your server.
settings.minimize_to_tray: Minimize to the system tray (keep running when closed)
settings.profile_switch: Shortcut: switch to the next profile
settings.timing_hint: The cooldown accepts decimals with a dot or a comma: 0.01 s = 10 ms is the minimum. Local cooldowns never override Discord's rate limits.
settings.title: NoKey Settings
settings.token_note: The token is encrypted with Windows DPAPI and never shown again.
settings.token_saved: Saved token {mask} · encrypted with Windows DPAPI
settings.update_help: A release needs two files: NoKey.exe and NoKey.exe.sha256. NoKey asks before downloading and again before installing.
settings.update_verified: Update downloaded; the SHA-256 checksum matches.
sort.name: Sort: name
status.all_disabled: All bindings are off (Ctrl + Alt + Pause to turn them on)
status.busy: {name}: the previous run is not finished yet.
tip.add_action: Add another action. They run one after another.
tip.combo_window: How quickly all keys of a simultaneous shortcut must go down (100–2000 ms).
tip.cooldown: Minimum time between two runs of this binding. Turn off "global" to set its own value.
tip.disable_all: Turns every binding off or back on. Works from anywhere with Ctrl + Alt + Pause.
tip.double_tap: Maximum time between the two presses of a Double Tap (100–1000 ms).
tip.fullscreen: Useful for games: the binding stays quiet while a fullscreen app is in front.
tip.global_cooldown: Default minimum time between two runs of the same binding (0.01–3600 s).
tip.icon: One emoji or letter shown in the list.
tip.long_press: How long keys must be held for a Long Press (200–5000 ms).
tip.more: Duplicate, delete, enable/disable or pause the selected binding.
tip.priority: When one key press matches several bindings, the highest priority runs.
tip.process: Program file name of the active window, e.g. chrome.exe or code.exe.
tip.profile: Only bindings of the active profile (and "All profiles") work.
tip.profile_switch: A global shortcut that switches to the next profile.
tip.repeat_max: Hard limit of runs for one activation (1–1000).
tip.search: Searches names, descriptions, actions and shortcuts.
tip.sequence_timeout: Maximum pause between two keys of a sequence (300–5000 ms).
tip.settings: Theme, language, Discord bot, profiles and updates.
tip.sort: Sort the list or show the bindings of all profiles.
tip.stop_on_failure: If an action fails, the remaining actions are skipped.
tip.theme: Applies at once. System follows the Windows light/dark setting.
tip.trigger: When the binding runs: on press, release, double tap, long press, while held, or on/off.
tip.window_title: Part of the active window's title, e.g. the name of a document.
